title: The essential norm, block sizes, and some Generalized Hilbert operators on lp
summary: We examine the generalized Hilbert (matrix) operators $$ H_{g,γ} : (a_n) \mapsto \sum_{n=1}^{\infty} \bigg(\frac{k}{n}\bigg)^γ \frac{g_k a_n}{n+k} $$ on the $\ell^p$ spaces, $1<p<\infty$, where $g=(g_n)$ is a sequence and $-1/p<γ<1-1/p$. Given a partition of the natural numbers $\bigcup_j I_j = \mathbb N$, we encode $g$ to our investigation via its $\ell^p$-means $G_j$ over the sets $I_j$. We prove that if $I_j$ increases exponentially, the data $(G_j)$ characterizes boundedness, but is insufficient to determine the exact value of the essential norm.
